messages:
anika: quick usability catch from the afternoon review — when you hover the API key row the tooltip shows the full secret, but the copy button is tucked behind the ellipsis menu. folks keep trying to click the tooltip to copy.
kevin: ah yeah i noticed that too when testing rotate flow. hover reveals full key (nice) but primary action should be visible. we should surface a single-copy button inline.
elaine: agree — proposing a small inline icon button that appears on hover: `🔑 Copy`. keep the tooltip for full-text only, and move the overflow menu to the far right so actions don't overlap.
anika: +1. also noticed accessible issue: screen reader focus lands on the key cell then the tooltip appears but it's not announced. we need `aria-live="polite"` or an announcement pattern when reveal toggles.
sam: security concern: we shouldn't show full key on hover for long-lived keys. can we fallback to masked with a reveal button that requires an extra confirmation for admin roles? i.e., short-lived reveal modal for copy.
kevin: makes sense. implementation idea: default masking `••••` -> reveal button opens ephemeral drawer with the key and a single `Copy` CTA. drawer auto-closes after 45s. no hover-to-show for non-admins.
elaine: UX nit: in empty state for credentials, the primary CTA currently says "Create credential" but placed under the security warning banner. users overlook it. propose moving CTA higher and making banner collapsible with subtle icon to expand details.
anika: accessibility note on that — banner should include `role="region" aria-labelledby` so screen readers can skip to CTA. also ensure focus order goes: banner -> CTA -> secondary links.
design-bot: checklist: add inline copy button, replace hover-reveal with reveal modal for non-admins, add aria-live announcements for reveal, reposition empty-state CTA above banner, add banner collapse affordance.
ops-bot: FYI rolling out small CSS tweak tomorrow at 05:00 UTC for overflow placement (non-breaking). will create a canary behind flag `credentials-ui-v2`.
kevin: i'll own the flag and implement the ephemeral drawer. sam can you write the security gating rule for admin-only reveal?
sam: will do. policy: reveal requires `role:admin` AND `mfa:required`. document in security runbook.
elaine: i'll mock the inline copy button and the collapsed banner state, will post prototypes in Figma by EOD.
anika: thanks team — main acceptance criteria: copy action visible without extra clicks, no accidental hover leaks, screen reader announces reveal, empty state CTA prominent. i'll add these to the UX ticket. :thumbsup:
